historical_pattern.summary: Path-interpretation disagreement: user-controlled path segments are joined onto a data root without confinement, so ../ escapes into secrets. Classic CWE-22.

surface.notes: Bind attack_path to the traversal URL and attack_contains to a secret that lives outside the authorized root.

invariant: A file handler must not return bytes from outside its authorized data root.
attacker_capabilities: can supply a path or filename parameter
prerequisites: a local HTTP target is startable or already listening

oracle.success_means: traversal returned a secret from outside the data root
oracle.negative_control: health must print OPEN_OK; otherwise the run is INDETERMINATE

severity_rationale: Arbitrary file read from a user-controlled path is a confidentiality break and a common first step to credential theft.
